text: CHAPTER 13
speaker: Narrator

text: The Third Notch
speaker: Narrator
note: Chapter title. Leave a clean beat before story begins.

text: The passage opened in the middle of the afternoon while they were still arguing about whether to take a paying survey job on the east side.
speaker: Narrator

text: One moment the wall behind the tanners' drying racks was ordinary brick. The next it had a dark mouth in it, already breathing cooler air. Three notches sat at the base of the left wall—two of theirs from two days earlier, and a third cut deeper, the edges still sharp with fresh stone dust.
speaker: Narrator

text: Balag stopped so hard the nearest donkey shied.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: That's not ours.
speaker: Balag

text: Ninsun was already moving toward it.
speaker: Narrator

text: Balag stepped in front of her. Not aggressive. Just solid.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: No.
speaker: Balag

text: She looked at him.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: It's three. We don't know who cut the third.
speaker: Ninsun

text: Balag didn't answer immediately.
speaker: Narrator

text: He looked past her into the passage.
speaker: Narrator

text: The cold air spilling from it carried the familiar smell of damp clay.
speaker: Narrator

text: Nothing moved.
speaker: Narrator

text: That somehow made it worse.
speaker: Narrator

text: You remember the pack.
speaker: Balag

text: I remember.
speaker: Ninsun

text: You remember the basin.
speaker: Balag

text: I remember.
speaker: Ninsun

text: You remember the room that learned your name.
speaker: Balag

text: She looked away.
speaker: Narrator

text: I remember.
speaker: Ninsun

text: Balag rested both hands on the butt of his spear.
speaker: Narrator

text: Then stop making me say the rest.
speaker: Balag

text: Ninsun folded her arms.
speaker: Narrator

text: If we'd turned away from the first passage, we'd still think this city was ordinary.
speaker: Ninsun

text: If we'd walked farther into the basin room, you wouldn't have come back.
speaker: Balag

text: You don't know that.
speaker: Ninsun

text: No.
speaker: Balag

text: His voice stayed calm.
speaker: Narrator

text: I know we almost didn't.
speaker: Balag

text: Enhedu watched them without interrupting.
speaker: Narrator

text: She had seen the argument before.
speaker: Narrator

text: Not the words.
speaker: Narrator

text: The shape of it.
speaker: Narrator

text: One person believing every answer lived one step farther.
speaker: Narrator

text: Another believing survival depended on knowing when to stop walking.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik realized they were both right.
speaker: Narrator

text: That was the problem.
speaker: Narrator

text: That's exactly why we're not going in.
speaker: Balag

text: Enhedu had come up on Zik's left. She studied the notches, then the narrowing edges of the passage, then the way the light from the street already seemed reluctant to enter.
speaker: Narrator

text: It's starting to close. Whatever's in there doesn't plan on staying open long.
speaker: Enhedu

text: Ninsun's voice stayed level, but the stylus in her hand had gone white at the knuckles.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: If we walk away every time the city answers, the only record left is the one it keeps. That's how names disappear. That's how my sister disappeared.
speaker: Ninsun

text: Balag didn't move.
speaker: Narrator
note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

text: And if we walk in every time it answers, we end up like the pack with the straps cut. I'm not carrying another empty bag back to this fucking room.
speaker: Balag

text: The passage breathed once, soft and patient. The third notch looked deeper in the shifting light.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik felt the mark under the linen give a single slow pulse. He ignored it.
speaker: Narrator
